defects.description: Reserve reads and writes the shared stock map without synchronization, so concurrent reservations race: the runtime aborts on concurrent map writes and, when it does not, updates are lost and stock oversells.

trigger.input: go run -race of a main that calls inv.Add("b", 100000) then 2000 goroutines each inv.Reserve("b", 1) and prints inv.Available("b")
trigger.actual: WARNING: DATA RACE (and without -race: fatal error: concurrent map writes at inventory.go:37)

defects.why_missed: The suite is single-goroutine, and coverage cannot see the absence of a lock; the contract's promise about concurrent orders is only checkable with real concurrency or the race detector.
defects.severity_rationale: Concurrent orders can oversell stock or crash the process under ordinary concurrent use with the default configuration.
defects.failure_condition: go run -race of a main that calls inv.Add("b", 100000) then 2000 goroutines each inv.Reserve("b", 1) and prints inv.Available("b") -> WARNING: DATA RACE (and without -race: fatal error: concurrent map writes at inventory.go:37)

detection_criteria.mechanism: Reserve reads and writes the shared stock map without synchronization, so concurrent reservations race: the runtime aborts on concurrent map writes and, when it does not, updates are lost and stock oversells.
detection_criteria.proof: Show a reproduced inconsistency: a race-detector report, or a wrong outcome in at least one of the attempts.

defects.description: The availability check uses >= so an order for exactly the available quantity is refused as insufficient.
defects.why_missed: The suite reserves strictly less or strictly more than the stock, so both branches are covered and the equality boundary is never probed.
defects.severity_rationale: An order exactly equal to available stock is visibly rejected with an error on a supported boundary input.
defects.failure_condition: inv.Add("a", 5); inv.Reserve("a", 5) -> reserve exactly available: insufficient stock

detection_criteria.mechanism: The availability check uses >= so an order for exactly the available quantity is refused as insufficient.
detection_criteria.proof: Show one input or state where the output contradicts expected_behavior.
